name: Esoru by resortlife.travel
tagline: AI concierge for planning and comparing Maldives resort holidays
description: Esoru is the free AI concierge from resortlife.travel, a Maldives destination management company founded in 2006 that works with 180+ resorts across 22 atolls. Ask it in plain language to find, compare and shortlist Maldives resorts by budget, atoll, transfer type, house reef, dive sites, surf breaks, family or honeymoon fit. It answers from resortlife.travel's own resort data with photos and maps. No login needed.
